description: This file defines the 'Dispatcher' class and 'ProtocolSession' class, handling message dispatching, session management, and event emission for a protocol communication system within a Firefox-related project.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Handles message dispatching, session management, and event emission for protocol communication.

classes.name: ProtocolSession
classes.description: Represents a session within the dispatcher, managing event handling and method dispatch.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new protocol session with a generated ID.

methods.name: _dispose
methods.description: Cleans up the dispatcher, closing connections and disposing sessions.

methods.name: _dispatch
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, routing them to appropriate session methods.

methods.name: _emitEvent
methods.description: Emits an event to the connection based on session ID and event name.

methods.name: setHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler object for the session.

methods.name: _dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the session, cleaning up handler and dispatcher references.

methods.name: emitEvent
methods.description: Emits an event from the session.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches a method call with parameters within the session.
